item.text: I’ll build a cylindrical shaft with a continuous helical flight, then compare the four views to refine its proportions.

arguments.code:
shaft = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(15).extrude(108)
path = cq.Wire.makeHelix(12, 66, 19)
flight = cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline([(14.8,-1.2),(24,-1.2),(24,1.2),(14.8,1.2)]).close().sweep(path, isFrenet=True).translate((0,0,21))
result = shaft.union(flight)
arguments.label: Shaft with continuous helical flight
